title: Data-Centric Safety and Ethical Measures for Data and AI Governance
findings: The paper does not address religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is on a general, domain-agnostic framework for data-centric AI safety and governance, mentioning general risks like bias and stereotypes without specific examples related to religion.
